description: Someone inside SAFETYNET handed ENTROPY the Portland deployment before it was signed. Two agents are dead. Go back to headquarters and find the traitor among your own colleagues, quietly, before they vanish.
title: Mission 8: The Mole
subtitle: Internal Investigation

keywords: PERSONAL IDENTIFICATION NUMBER AND MEMORABLE INFORMATION
